19: Then the adapter persists and resolves the session payload, confirms revoked token/session blacklist membership until TTL expiry, acquires exclusive distributed leases via atomic `SET NX PX` semantics, renews active leases only when the caller holds the matching lease token, and releases the lease on completion or expiry
20: 
21: ### AC-2 — fail closed with SESSION_STORE_UNAVAILABLE when Redis session or revocation check is unreachable or times out
22: Kind: negative
23: Given an incoming authenticated request or token revocation verification against the Redi

80: - **Sensitive actions & audit integrity (for Design evaluation)**: Post-endorsement SAP archival handoff (`archiveEndorsedArtifact` + `SapPostingConnectorPort.publishArchivedPosting`) requires atomic failure propagation so that any S3 archive copy error or SAP log-connector failure aborts the enclosing `SAP_REPORT_POSTING` approval transaction, and all dynamic values written to `SAP_REPORT_POSTING_ARCHIVED` logs are sanitized with `Encode.forJava()` (`security-baseline.mdc` §3, §12; VAPT F10; `AC-6`).
81: 
82: ## Regulations
83: 
84: - **BSP (Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas) Circular 982 / 1019 (IT Risk Management & Financial Audit Controls)**: Requires non-repudiable maker-checker ledger handoff trails (`SAP_REPORT_POSTING_ARCHIVED`), SHA-256 checksum verification (`checksum_sha256`) on all financial CSV artifacts, immutable post-approval archive storage (`_v2` / timestamp collision preservation without overwrite), and fail-closed session/access controls.
85: - **Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR**: Requires secure server-side session handling, strict TTL expiration and revocation of operator session claims in Redis, and least-privilege storage key isolation across `sources`, `artifacts`, and `archive` buckets.
86: - **Internal GXI Enterprise Governance & Security Baseline (`security-baseline.mdc` §1, §2, §3, §5, §11, §12)**: Mandates fail-closed session/revocation verification (VAPT F9), `< 50 MB` streaming upload size enforcement with server-generated storage keys and path-traversal refusal, `Encode.forJava()` log sanitization on structured SAP archival events (VAPT F10), and ArchUnit bounded-context isolation.

4: - **Status:** Accepted

7: - **Deciders:** mdurana

9: ## Context
10: 
11: Story `P1-D` (`p1-d-execution-and-governance-persistence`) delivers the physical Flyway persistence migration (`V4__execution_and_governance_schema.sql`), domain models, JDBC repositories, cross-context `ExecutionFreezePort` (`hasInFlightRuns`), and ArchUnit bounded-context isolation rules for the `execution` (`com.example.app.execution`) and `governance` (`com.example.app.governance`) bounded contexts inside `app/backend/`. Governing requirements from `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p1-d-execution-and-governance-persistence.md`, `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/report-execution.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/governance-ticketing.md`, and `ADR 0001` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0001-modular-monolith-architecture.md`) establish five non-trivial persistence and boundary constraints:
12: 
13: 1. **Physical Schema for Report Runs, Run Artifacts, Universal Governance Tickets, Comments, and Attachments (`AC-1`, `AC-3`):**
14:    - `report_runs` must persist run tracking, input/output/exception row counts, idempotency key deduplication (`uq_report_runs_idempotency_key`), unique business run numbers (`uq_report_runs_run_number`), optimistic concurrency (`version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`), and named foreign keys `fk_runs_definition` (`report_definitions.id`), `fk_runs_recipe` (`recipe_versions.id`), and `fk_runs_triggered_by` (`users.id`).
15:    - `run_artifacts` must persist generated artifact metadata (`SOURCE`
<truncated 14703 bytes>
SAP_REPORT_POSTING` ticket preserves the target `SUCCESS` `report_runs` row and its `run_artifacts` (`AC-5`).
78:   - `LayerRulesTest` verifies that no class outside `execution` or `governance` can bypass exposed ports to touch `com.example.app.execution.{repository,entity,domain}..` or `com.example.app.governance.{repository,entity,domain}..` (`AC-6`).
79: - **Negative:**
80:   - Purging records older than the 13-month online retention window (after archival to 7-year cold storage) requires a privileged DBA maintenance script that temporarily disables the immutability triggers inside a controlled maintenance transaction (`docs/agents-v0/design/system/ops-readiness.md`).
81: - **Neutral:**
82:   - Deferred configuration/IAM back-reference foreign keys (`recipe_versions.approved_ticket_id`, `schedule_configs.last_approved_ticket_id`, `reference_table_versions.approved_ticket_id`, `user_role_assignments.source_ticket_id`) remain nullable UUID columns for `P2`/`P3` workflow orchestration per `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p1-d-execution-and-governance-persistence.md` (`## Out of scope`).
83: 
84: ## Compliance
85: 
86: - `architecture-and-diagrams.mdc`: Matches the physical schema (`report_runs`, `run_artifacts`, `governance_tickets`, `ticket_comments`, `ticket_attachments`), partial index `idx_report_runs_active_by_def`, and state machines in `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, `report-execution.md`, and `governance-ticketing.md`.
87: - `security-baseline.mdc`: Enforces database-level immutability on terminal maker-checker tickets and append-only artifacts, comments, and attachments (§4, §5, §11), SHA-256 checksum integrity (`checksum_sha256`), idempotency key uniqueness (`idempotency_key`), optimistic concurrency (`version`), and ArchUnit bounded-context isolation (§2, F8).
88: - `project-delivery-core.mdc`: Uses `Pack: java` (`Java 21`, `Spring Boot 4.1.1`, `PostgreSQL 15`, `Flyway`, `ArchUnit 1.4.2`) with expand-and-contract `migration-safety` discipline; introduces no new message broker or cache infrastructure.

19: Then the adapter persists and resolves the session payload, confirms revoked token/session blacklist membership until TTL expiry, acquires exclusive distributed leases via atomic `SET NX PX` semantics, renews active leases only when the caller holds the matching lease token, and releases the lease on completion or expiry

22: Kind: negative

80: - **Sensitive actions & audit integrity (for Design evaluation)**: Post-endorsement SAP archival handoff (`archiveEndorsedArtifact` + `SapPostingConnectorPort.publishArchivedPosting`) requires atomic failure propagation so that any S3 archive copy error or SAP log-connector failure aborts the enclosing `SAP_REPORT_POSTING` approval transaction, and all dynamic values written to `SAP_REPORT_POSTING_ARCHIVED` logs are sanitized with `Encode.forJava()` (`security-baseline.mdc` §3, §12; VAPT F10; `AC-6`).

83: 
84: - **BSP (Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas) Circular 982 / 1019 (IT Risk Management & Financial Audit Controls)**: Requires non-repudiable maker-checker ledger handoff trails (`SAP_REPORT_POSTING_ARCHIVED`), SHA-256 checksum verification (`checksum_sha256`) on all financial CSV artifacts, immutable post-approval archive storage (`_v2` / timestamp collision preservation without overwrite), and fail-closed session/access controls.
85: - **Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR**: Requires secure server-side session handling, strict TTL expiration and revocation of operator session claims in Redis, and least-privilege storage key isolation across `sources`, `artifacts`, and `archive` buckets.
86: - **Internal GXI Enterprise Governance & Security Baseline (`security-baseline.mdc` §1, §2, §3, §5, §11, §12)**: Mandates fail-closed session/revocation verification (VAPT F9), `< 50 MB` streaming upload size enforcement with server-generated storage keys and path-traversal refusal, `Encode.forJava()` log sanitization on structured SAP archival events (VAPT F10), and ArchUnit bounded-context isolation.
